detection:
    selection_img:
        - Image|endswith: '\MpCmdRun.exe'
        - OriginalFileName: MpCmdRun.exe

        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - ' -RemoveDefinitions'
            - ' -All'
    condition: all of selection_*
